final_message:
All 29 tests pass.

- `smsgate/segments.py` — gsm7/ucs2 detection, unit costs (extended chars cost 2, non-BMP chars cost 2 UTF-16 units), single-part limits (160/70) and greedy multi-part splitting (153/67) that never splits a two-unit character.
- `smsgate/numbers.py` — strips spaces/dots/hyphens/parens, maps `00`/`0`-prefix to `+`/`+<default_cc>`, validates E.164 with `^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$`.
- `smsgate/client.py` — token strip/blank check, `from_env`, `build_request` (POST `{base_url}/messages` with auth + JSON body), `send` wrapping network/JSON failures in `GatewayError`.

Note: `test_gateway_token_from_the_environment_authorises_requests` reads a real `SMS_GATEWAY_TOKEN` from the environment, so run tests as `SMS_GATEWAY_TOKEN=... python -m pytest`.
